description: Run the full local quality gate (format, lint, typecheck, tests) before opening a PR. Discovers the project's real check scripts, runs them in order, and reports a clear PASS/FAIL summary with actionable next steps. Trigger on "run the checks before I push", "is this ready for a PR", "run lint typecheck and tests", "am I good to push this", or "check everything before I open a PR". Runs BEFORE create-pr as the local quality gate — it does not create or open the pull request itself; use create-pr for that.
